title: Musk Departs DOGE After Criticizing Trump's Spending Bill
description_short: Musk Departs DOGE After Criticizing Trump's Spending Bill
description_medium: Elon Musk's off-boarding from DOGE began the night of May 28, 2025, after he publicly criticized Trump's 'Big Beautiful Bill' spending package as undermining DOGE's work. Reuters reported Musk did not have a formal conversation with Trump before announcing his exit. At departure, DOGE's website claimed $175 billion in savings — a fraction of the trillions Musk had promised — and the national debt had grown by more than $2.2 trillion during the same fiscal year.
description_long: Reuters reported that Elon Musk's departure from DOGE began the night of May 28, 2025, after he criticized Trump's major spending bill as undermining DOGE's work. The supplied account says Musk did not have a formal conversation with Trump before announcing the exit. At the time, DOGE's website claimed $175 billion in savings, substantially below the trillions Musk had promised. The account separately notes that national debt had increased by more than $2.2 trillion in the same fiscal year. Those figures measure different things: an agency's claimed savings cannot be directly subtracted from the government's total borrowing to produce a complete evaluation of its performance. The event records Musk's departure amid disagreement over spending policy and the gap between the announced savings target and the website's claim. It does not independently verify all claimed savings or establish that DOGE was responsible for the entire increase in national debt.
